displayName: Walgreens Product Data API - Prices, Store Stock, Stores
description: Walgreens product data as structured JSON - search walgreens.com retail products with regular and sale price, unit price, promotions, coupons, rewards and rebates, read one product with UPC, ingredients, warnings and offers, find Walgreens and Duane Reade stores near a ZIP, and check live unit counts of one product at up to 20 stores in one call. 4 endpoints; search, product and stores 2 credits, stock 4.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
